title: v0.5.22-alpha — HUD Always Visible + Merchants on Starting Map
body: HUD hotbar is now always at full brightness — day/night lighting no longer darkens the UI. Mira the Merchant (ale, chalk, enchanting crystal, free gold), two Bounty Boards, and a Tester NPC are now on the starting map near the trainers.

title: v0.5.21-alpha — Bug Fixes: HUD, Combat Lock, Targeting & Weapon Range
body: HUD no longer disappears on login. Left-click now selects your target. Combat lock is active when an NPC aggros you — fight or flee, you can't just walk away. Weapon range is now accurate: bows reach 5 tiles, staves 4, wands 3, swords/axes 1 (some rares 2). Tester NPC and Bounty Boards added to the starting map.

title: v0.5.20-alpha — Right-Click Social, Enchanted Drops & Drunk Effects
body: Right-click any player for quick social actions: Duel, Carry, Pickpocket, and Propose. Signs now require Chalk (buy from Mira the Merchant on the starting map). Bounties can only be posted at a Bounty Board. NPCs now drop rare pre-enchanted weapons and armor — uncommon through legendary. Drunk now tilts your camera and pulses a green overlay that fades as you sober up. Stumble chance raised to 40%. Drunk also reduces attack damage 15-20%.

title: v0.5.19-alpha — Combat Targeting Fixes
body: When an NPC aggros you, your target now auto-locks onto them. Tab cycles through nearby targets and Space attacks. The yellow selection bracket no longer appears on your own character. Footstep sounds now cycle through 4 variants.

title: v0.5.18-alpha — Social Sandbox & Duel System
body: Massive social update. Challenge players to duels — spectators can place gold bets on the outcome. Pick someone up and throw them. Pickpocket nearby players for a cut of their gold. Wear a disguise helm to hide your name. Place signs and graffiti anywhere on the map. Post bounties on players, propose marriage for a shared XP bonus, and watch your karma shift between Lawful and Chaotic based on your choices. Drink ale to get properly drunk. Bug fix: yellow target bracket no longer appears on your own character.

title: v0.5.10-alpha — NPC Rendering, Damage & Trainers
body: NPCs now render correctly when switching between maps. Player and NPC combat damage is fully live — equip a weapon and attack from your hotbar. Ability trainers now open the skill shop when you interact. Launcher login button now shows correctly before you sign in.

title: v0.5.8-alpha — Launcher Login & Char Creation
body: Log in once from the launcher and stay logged in. Character creation now refreshes the selection screen instantly. Quit-to-menu no longer leaves the HUD on screen.

title: v0.5.0-alpha — First Multiplayer Test
body: Directional melee combat, PK gold loot, dead body visuals, vendor fixes, bank partial withdrawal, and the new auto-updating launcher. Thanks to everyone who helped test!
